Description & Requirements:
We are more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. • Familiarity with mainframe environments and the ability to read COBOL code.
• Programming/software engineering related certifications a plus and/or an active desire to pursue such certifications.

jobs.text:
Position: AS400 Administrator

Location: Plano, TX (Onsite)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced AS400 Administrator to manage, maintain, support, and optimize IBM AS400 (IBM i) systems. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in system administration, infrastructure management, performance monitoring, backup and recovery, security administration, and troubleshooting in an AS400 environment.

Key Responsibilities
• Install, configure, administer, and maintain IBM AS400 / IBM i systems.
• Monitor system performance, availability, and overall infrastructure health.
• Perform system upgrades, PTF installations, patch management, and system maintenance.
• Manage user profiles, system security, access controls, and permissions.
• Handle backup, recovery, and disaster recovery operations.
• Monitor and troubleshoot system jobs, subsystems, job queues, and batch processing.
• Manage system storage, disk utilization, and performance optimization.
• Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions.
• Identify and resolve system issues, outages, and performance bottlenecks.
• Coordinate with application, database, network, and infrastructure teams.
• Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and system configurations.

Required Technical Skills
• Strong hands-on experience with IBM AS400 / IBM i administration.
• Knowledge of IBM i operating systems and system architecture.
• Experience with IBM i system commands and CL (Control Language).
• Knowledge of job scheduling, job queues, subsystems, and batch jobs.
• Experience with backup and recovery tools such as BRMS.
• Knowledge of PTF management, system upgrades, and patching.
• Experience with user administration, security, and access management.
• Strong troubleshooting and system performance monitoring skills.
• Understanding of high availability and disaster recovery concepts.
• Familiarity with DB2 for IBM i is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Relevant IBM i / AS400 certifications are an advantage.
• Experience supporting enterprise-level AS400 environments.
• Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Additional Information
